extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia editors/contributors (particularly new users trying to create or locate an article)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for locating or creating a Wikipedia article when a searched title does not exist, including account requirements, naming conventions, alternatives (drafts/requests), and diagnostic steps (deletion log, caching).

rubrics_metrics.name: Article existence check
rubrics_metrics.description: Wikipedia does not have an article with this exact name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search for the title in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings; use Wikipedia's search function and check for pages that link to the title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New or anonymous users cannot create articles directly; ensure you have an account and meet autoconfirmed status before attempting to create a page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard / submit draft or request article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create a live article (e.g., not autoconfirmed), prepare a draft via the article wizard or use the 'request a new article' workflows so experienced editors can review and create the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for recent creation / caching delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you or someone else just created the page, allow time for propagation or use the purge cache function to refresh; don't recreate immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and spelling variants; if the correct article exists under a different capitalization or variant, create or request a redirect rather than a duplicate page.

rubrics_metrics.name: If deleted, consult deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the deletion log to understand deletion reasons (notability, copyright, vandalism, etc.) before attempting recreation; address the cause if recreating.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages linking to the title (What links here)
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'What links here' to find incoming links or mentions which may indicate alternative titles, redirections, or contexts where the topic is covered; this helps avoid duplication and locate existing content.
